{{Quote|So, in your mind, I'm just like any other pirate.''"<br />"''Am I wrong?''"<br />"''Not entirely.|Sugi, and Obi-Wan Kenobi|<ref name="BountyHunters" />}}
'''Sugi''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] who worked as a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] and [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] during the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] conflict known as the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. A native of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Iridonia/Legends|Iridonia]] in the galaxy's [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]], Sugi owned the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Halo/Legends|''Halo'']], and had grown strong through [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of hunting [[Bounty/Legends|bounties]]; her equally strong sense of honor and duty guided her choices in her sometimes morally murky profession. One such contract she accepted was in defense of a [[Felucian/Legends|Felucian]] [[Nysillin/Legends|nysillin]]-[[Farm/Legends|farming]] [[Akira/Legends|village]], plagued by the [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] of the [[Ohnaka Gang/Legends|Ohnaka Gang]]. Together with a crew of fellow [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]]-for-hire that included the likes of the [[Frenk/Legends|Frenk]] [[Rumi Paramita/Legends|Rumi Paramita]], the [[Kyuzo/Legends|Kyuzo]] named [[Embo/Legends|Embo]], and the heavily [[Armor/Legends|armored]] [[Seripas/Legends|Seripas]], Sugi traveled to [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]], where she and the others found themselves joining forces with a trio of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]&mdash;[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], and Skywalker's [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]]&mdash;in defense of the village. With the help of the Jedi, Sugi and her crew [[Skirmish on Felucia/Legends|fought off]] the pirates and their leader, [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]], though Paramita [[Death/Legends|fell]] and Embo was wounded during the battle. Once the pirates were gone, Sugi and her remaining allies received their payment and offered the previously stranded Jedi a ride off of Felucia and back to [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Realspace/Legends|space]] aboard her ship.

==Biography==
===Early life and career===
Sugi was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]], born on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Iridonia/Legends|Iridonia]],<ref name="TCWCE" /> a world located in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Episode I">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Episode I]]''</ref> When she grew older, Sugi decided to become a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] and work as a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]]. [[Standard year/Legends|Years]] of hunting [[Bounty/Legends|bounties]] made her strong,<ref name="NewBattlefronts" /> and at some point Sugi acquired an [[SS-54 assault ship/Legends|SS-54 assault ship]] known as [[Halo/Legends|''Halo'']], which she utilized as her personal [[Transport/Legends|transport]] during her career<ref name="TCWEGS1&2">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Official Episode Guide Series 1 & 2]]''</ref> and became its captain. She added a crew cabin, refresher, space for supplies, and converted the gunship's stern hold.<ref name=":0">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Incredible Vehicles|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Incredible Vehicles'']]</ref>

By the start of the galaxy-spanning conflict known as the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], fought between the forces of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], the Republic had issued a significant [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credit]] bounty on Sugi totaling 25,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] for supposed crimes she had committed against the galactic government.<ref name="Wanted">{{SWArchive|url=media/kids/tcw/cwbountyhunters.pdf|text=Get Ready for ''The Clone Wars'' with Downloadable Goodies}}</ref>

===Felucian protector===
{{Quote|Might I suggest—''"<br />"''You ''might'' suggest anything you like, General Kenobi. But I know what I'm doing, and I will keep these people safe, ''my'' way.|Obi-Wan Kenobi and Sugi|<ref name="BountyHunters" />}}
[[File:Sugiandothers.png|thumb|left|270x270px|Sugi and her band of mercenaries on Felucia]]
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> Sugi was hired by a group of [[Nysillin/Legends|nysillin]] [[Farm/Legends|farmers]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] world of [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]]: [[Felucian/Legends|the farmers]] had become the victims of extortion at the [[Limb/Legends|hands]] of a [[Ohnaka Gang/Legends|gang]] of [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]], and Sugi was contracted to put an end to the pirates' illegal actions. Together with a group of<ref name="BountyHunters" /> loose-knit band of bounty hunters<ref>{{SWE|locations|felucia|Felucia}}</ref>—among them, the [[Kyuzo/Legends|Kyuzo]] named [[Embo/Legends|Embo]], the [[Frenk/Legends|Frenk]] known as [[Rumi Paramita/Legends|Rumi Paramita]], and the heavily [[Armor/Legends|armored]] [[Seripas/Legends|Seripas]]—Sugi journeyed to Felucia. There, Sugi and the others negotiated a fee the farmers found generous in comparison to the pirates' demands.<ref name="BountyHunters" /> Sugi had come to rely on Paramita as second-in-command for her keen judgment and her easy way with potential customers.<ref name="TCWCE" />

However, before Sugi and her team could confront the pirates, the farmers' village of [[Akira/Legends|Akira]] was found by a trio of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] who had become stranded on the planet after their [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] crashed. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], and Skywalker's [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], accused Sugi and her mercenary crew of attempting to extort the impoverished village, but the village leader, [[Casiss/Legends|Casiss]], instead requested the Jedi's aid in defending his people's homes. Sugi was quick to remind Casiss that he had already contracted her and the other mercenaries to do the job, wishing to ensure that she and her crew were paid for the job they had come to complete, but Obi-Wan Kenobi admitted that the Jedi would be unable to help, anyway.<ref name="BountyHunters" />

When the pirates later rode into Akira atop [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bikes]], Sugi took it upon herself to speak on behalf of the village, demanding that the pirates either purchase the nysillin they were after, or leave the village in peace. The pirates' leader, [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]], however, dismissed the bounty hunter's words and offered to pay the mercenaries off with a higher sum should they merely step aside and let his gang continue their extortion of the farmers. Sugi would hear nothing of it, and refused to break the deal she and the others had previously brokered with the Felucian farmers; Ohnaka made a final threat to the farmers before he and his gang left. With that, the Jedi decided to train the farmers in combat, while Sugi oversaw the nysillin harvest. After ordering the farmers to store the nysillin in their large barn, where her ship was also being kept safe, Kenobi questioned Sugi's motives and compared her to the pirates she now stood against. Undaunted, she explained that she was not as profit-driven as Kenobi believed, and cared for the safety of the villagers. She later spotted one of the Weequay pirates [[Scout/Legends|scouting]] the village for Ohnaka, and ordered Embo to neutralize him, which the Kyuzo mercenary accomplished by breaking the pirate's neck.<ref name="BountyHunters" />

[[File:PirateSlayer.png|thumb|270x270px|Sugi killing Weequay pirates with her EE-3 blaster]]
Soon after, the pirates attacked and, together with the Jedi, Sugi and her mercenary crew [[Skirmish on Felucia/Legends|battled]] them. When Embo was injured by a blast from [[WLO-5 speeder tank/Legends|Ohnaka's tank]], Sugi ran to his aid and escorted him to the safety of the barn. Rumi Paramita also fell victim to a blast from the [[Tank/Legends|tank's]] [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]], although she was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the attack. Moments later, Sugi shot and killed two pirates in retaliation for her ally's death. The battle with the pirates ended when Skywalker engaged Ohnaka, defeating the pirate captain and forcing him to retreat. Free of their harassers, the Felucian villagers praised and thanked Sugi and the others, and paid them for their services. With the job finished, Sugi offered the previously stranded Jedi a ride aboard her starship back to Republic [[Realspace/Legends|space]], which the Jedi accepted.<ref name="BountyHunters" />

[[21 BBY/Legends|A year later]], during the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation's]] [[Blockade of Pantora/Legends|Blockade of Pantora]], Sugi and Embo spent time on the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] world of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], at [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|the palace]] of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]].<ref name="Sphere of Influence">''{{TCW|Sphere of Influence}}</ref>

===Rescue mission to Wasskah===
{{Quote|Make it quick, general. We're charging by the minute, and if my ship gets damaged it will cost you extra.|Sugi to [[Tarfful/Legends|Tarfful]]|<ref name="WH">{{TCW|Wookiee Hunt}}</ref>}}
Later in the war, Sugi was hired by a squad of [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] to help rescue [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], Ahsoka, [[Jinx/Legends|Jinx]] and [[O-Mer/Legends|O-Mer]] from a group of [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] hunters on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Wasskah/Legends|Wasskah]]. She piloted the ''Halo'' alongside Seripas, while the Wookiees fought the Trandoshans. They were successful in their rescue of Chewbacca and the Padawans, and Sugi later flew them back to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="WH" /> While there she kept the ''[[Halo/Legends|Halo]]''<nowiki/>'s engines warm, as the Republic authorities didn't approve of guns for hire, even when they helped Jedi.<ref name=":0" /> She and Seripas were later at the [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Mos Eisley Cantina]].<ref>{{TCW|Revenge (episode)}}</ref>

===Bodyguard duty===
[[File:Sugi and embo vs sith.jpg|thumb|270x270px|Sugi and [[Embo/Legends|Embo]] faces the newfound [[Sith/Legends|Sith]].]]
Sugi was later hired by the [[Grand Hutt Council/Legends|Hutt Grand Council]] as a bodyguard along with [[Dengar/Legends|Dengar]], Embo, [[Latts Razzi/Legends|Latts Razzi]] and others. She was present when [[Darth Maul/Legends|Maul]] threatened the Council with death unless they served him. In response the Hutts ordered her and her fellow bounty hunters to kill Maul. Sugi's knife throw proved futile to Force users as [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage]] halted it and the knife went hurling back to the feet of Embo's [[Anooba/Legends|Anooba]], [[Marrok (anooba)/Legends|Marrok]]. [[Pre Vizsla/Legends|Pre Vizsla]] used his flame thrower to push them all back while they retreated. When Mandalorian reinforcements arrived, Sugi and Embo ambushed the trio. Sugi knocked down Maul and kicked back Vizsla. Maul recovered quickly and tried to cut her down while she was on the floor. Marrok saved her when he attacked the Sith Lord and fought him. When she reengaged him, she was quickly beaten by the Sith Lord. Latts Razzi and Dengar then threw smoke grenades to cover their escape. Maul let them go, reasoning that they were only bounty hunters and had no affiliation with anyone.<ref>{{TCW|Eminence (episode)}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Oh, come, come, my dear. How much are they paying you? ''Bububub!'' It does not matter. Whatever it is, I will double it. And all you have to do to earn it is, uh...''step aside."<br />"''We don't break deals.|Hondo Ohnaka and Sugi|<ref name="BountyHunters" />}}
[[File:SassySugi.png|thumb|left|270x270px|Sugi was a bounty hunter who was confident in her skills]]
A strong, reliable woman, Sugi honed her strength and skills over years of bounty hunting and mercenary work.<ref name="NewBattlefronts" /> An able tactician and a proficient marksman, she was confident in her abilities but knew better than to turn down an offer of assistance when faced with a difficult job. Though her services came at a price, Sugi was not one to favor profits over people, even offering a lesser fee to impoverished farmers on Felucia to deal with the pirates harassing them.<ref name="BountyHunters" /> The female Zabrak mercenary possessed a strong sense of honor and duty, unwilling to alter her loyalties once she had accepted a contract, even when offered a larger payout by an opposing third party:<ref name="NewBattlefronts" /><ref name="BountyHunters" /> she took jobs she believed in, contrary to what others may think.<ref>{{SWE|characters|sugi|Sugi}}</ref> Sugi believed in defending her clients even when presented with a significant risk to her own life, willing to die in order to protect her charge.<ref name="NewBattlefronts" /> Though loyal to her employers and comrades, Sugi was suspicious of Jedi, and resented the Republic's guardians for claiming to be peacekeepers while acting as [[General/Legends|generals]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. Despite this, Sugi offered the Jedi trio of Obi-Wan Kenobi, Anakin Skywalker, and Ahsoka Tano passage on her ship, ''Halo'', back to Republic space after the three assisted Sugi and her mercenary team in defending a Felucian village from pirates.<ref name="BountyHunters" />

Sugi showed compassion for her fellow mercenaries as well, lamenting the loss of Paramita and rushing to Embo's side when he was wounded. Despite this, she showed no mercy for her enemies.<ref name="BountyHunters" /> She indeed violent, especially fond of her powerful rifle and vibroblade to settle conflicts.<ref>[[Star Wars and History|''Star Wars and History'']]</ref>

As a Zabrak, Sugi possessed a ring of vestigial horns around the crown of her head, and hair of a deep purple [[Color/Legends|color]]. She preferred to wear her hair up, tied in a T-shaped topknot to keep it out of the way.<ref name="NewBattlefronts" /> Like many other Zabraks who [[Homeworld/Legends|hailed]] from Iridonia,{{Fact}} Sugi donned an intricate pattern of facial [[Tattoo/Legends|tattoos]]<ref name="BountyHunters" />  and had a strength built up over years of fighting.<ref name="TCWCE" />

==Equipment==
[[File:Sugi-SWI125.png|thumb|right|200px|Sugi, wielding her EE-3 blaster carbine]]
{{Quote|That's ''our'' ride. It doesn't go anywhere without ''us'', and right now, we're busy.|Sugi, referring to her ship, ''Halo''|<ref name="BountyHunters" />}}
An experienced bounty hunter,<ref name="NewBattlefronts" /> Sugi could utilize both a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]]<ref name="BountyHunters" /> and [[Vibrodagger/Legends|vibrodagger]] in combat.<ref name="Wanted" /> Her weapon of choice, however, was an [[EE-3 carbine rifle/Legends|EE-3 carbine rifle]],<ref name="BountyHunters" /> a weapon later made famous by the renowned [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] bounty hunter [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]].<ref name="Legacy of the Force: Bloodlines">''[[Legacy of the Force: Bloodlines]]''</ref> Sugi wielded the [[Blaster carbine/Legends|carbine]] [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] with a single [[Limb/Legends|hand]] in a similar fashion to a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]], and occasionally did so with a tilted grip. When not using her EE-3, the female Zabrak kept the weapon slung across her back.<ref name="BountyHunters" /> Sugi's [[Utility belt/Legends|utility belt]] was adorned with several pouches, and she wore armored [[Gauntlet/Legends|gauntlets]] of a metallic gray on both forearms over fingerless [[Glove/Legends|gloves]].<ref name="NewBattlefronts" /> For transportation, Sugi made use of her personal starship, an SS-54 [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighter]] built by [[Botajef Shipyards/Legends|Botajef Shipyards]] known as ''Halo''.<ref name="TCWEGS1&2" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sugi first appeared in ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in the seventeenth episode of [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''The Clone Wars'' television series]]' [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|second season]], entitled "[[Bounty Hunters (episode)|Bounty Hunters]]". She was voiced by actor [[Anna Graves]], who also voiced Rumi Paramita in the same episode,<ref name="BountyHunters" /> in addition to having previously provided the voice of [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]].<ref>{{TCW|The Mandalore Plot}}</ref> Graves' portrayal of Sugi included a noticeable [[:Wikipedia:Russia|Russian]] or [[:Wikipedia:Eastern Europe|Eastern European]] accent.

The animators mainly used [[Eeth Koth/Legends|Eeth Koth]] as an inspiration for her. There was some debate on whether or not she should have horns, but since it was never defined, they decided to give her horns.<ref>{{InsiderCite|117|Star Wars: The Unusual Suspects|''Star Wars'': The Unusual Suspects|reprint=1}}</ref> Sugi was noted for being a bounty hunter with a conscience, as up until this point bounty hunters had been portrayed as amoral.<ref>{{SW|url=news/chronicling-the-clone-wars-7|text=Chronicling ''The Clone Wars'' #7|int=Chronicling The Clone Wars}}</ref>
